blocks.text: Every queen on the Miss Universe stage arrives with a story, and the Philippines has never been a quiet audience for it. This week, PlayTime Entertainment steps in beside the journey as Official Journey Partner of the 75th Miss Universe, bringing two of the pageant’s most watched nights to Filipino viewers as they happen. Because the shows are staged in the evening in Puerto Rico, they land in the Philippines at breakfast time. The National Costume Show (Nov 21, Puerto Rico) will be livestreamed on the morning of Sunday, Nov 22, 7: 00 AM Philippine time. The Preliminary Show (Nov 22, […]...
